Linda Ross, specially appearing for Defendant December Wright;
December Wright, Defendant in Propria Persona

Settlement Conference held. Case settled. The following terms were read into the record:
- Restitution and possession of premises located at 361 Waller Street, #2, S.F., CA.
- Stipulation for judgment shall be stayed unless deft fails to pay pltf. the amount of $3875.-.
- Within 10 days of execution of this agreement, deft shall pay pltf. $500.00 as partial
payment of back rent.
- On the 6th day of ea. month ending on 9/6/04 deft will pay the amount of $520.50 for back rent.
- Deft further agrees to pay monthly rent of $775.00 due on the 5th of each month and late fee if paid after the 15th of the month.
- If deft complies with the payment agreement, pltf. shall dismiss the unlawful detainer
with prejudice and deft will continue to remain in possession of premises.
- If deft failed to comply, pltf. may upon 24 hours' notice to deft seek an ex-parte application for judgment for possession of premises.
Please refer to court reporter transcripts for further terms and conditions.
Jury trial vacated.
